title: A shared process harness and a shared e2e helper module
description: The test machinery is about twice the product and is copied, not shared: cmd/jellyscale's test files each define their own process, log sink, free-port and sign-in helpers (several clashed when parallel tasks met), and the e2e gates each define login, viewer, scenario, sql, waitFor and time.
acceptanceCriteria: cmd/jellyscale test files define no process type, log sink, free-port helper or sign-in helper of their own
Each of login, viewer, scenario, sql, ffmpegRuns, waitFor and time is defined once under test/e2e (a script check)
Every scenario name that ran before runs after (the recorded lists compared)
